# PacificaRomania

> PacificaRomania is a private curatorial collection of over 150 works of Pacific and Island Southeast Asian art — Aboriginal Australia, Melanesia, Micronesia, Polynesia, and Island Southeast Asia — read through the comparative lens of Mircea Eliade and Constantin Brâncuși. First exhibited at the Embassy of Romania in Canberra (2019–2020).

## Pages

- [About — PacificaRomania](https://www.pacificaromania.space/about.html): PacificaRomania is a private collection and curatorial project reading Pacific and Southeast Asian art through the comparative lens of Mircea Eliade and Constantin Brâncuși.
- [Australia — PacificaRomania Collection](https://www.pacificaromania.space/collection/australia.html): Australia: Dreaming, Desert Law & the Longest Living Tradition. Objects from the PacificaRomania collection.
- [Island Southeast Asia — PacificaRomania Collection](https://www.pacificaromania.space/collection/island-southeast-asia.html): Beyond the Pacific: Dayak baby carriers, Batak medicine vessels, Burmese weights, and the shamanic masks of the Malaysian Orang Asli.
- [Melanesia — PacificaRomania Collection](https://www.pacificaromania.space/collection/melanesia.html): Melanesia: The Great Engine of Ritual Invention. Objects from the PacificaRomania collection.
- [Micronesia — PacificaRomania Collection](https://www.pacificaromania.space/collection/micronesia.html): Micronesia: A Cartographic Metaphysics of the Atoll. Objects from the PacificaRomania collection.
- [Polynesia — PacificaRomania Collection](https://www.pacificaromania.space/collection/polynesia.html): Polynesia: Art as Genealogical Inscription. Objects from the PacificaRomania collection.
- [Collection — PacificaRomania](https://www.pacificaromania.space/collection.html): Over 150 works of Pacific and Island Southeast Asian art, first exhibited at the Embassy of Romania in Canberra (2019–2020). Browse by region: Australia, Melanesia, Micronesia, Polynesia, and Island Southeast Asia.
- [Contact — PacificaRomania](https://www.pacificaromania.space/contact.html): Get in touch with the PacificaRomania collection.
- [PacificaRomania — An Art Collection Between Romania and the Pacific](https://www.pacificaromania.space/): PacificaRomania is a curatorial collection exploring the living cosmologies of Aboriginal Australia, Melanesia, and Island Southeast Asia, read through the comparative lens of Mircea Eliade and Constantin Brâncuși.
- [Aboriginal Birds in Space — PacificaRomania Journal](https://www.pacificaromania.space/journal/aboriginal-birds-in-space.html): A preface to the installation: Seven Sisters Dreaming, Arnhem Land poles, and Brâncuși
- [The “Picasso of the Pacific” — PacificaRomania Journal](https://www.pacificaromania.space/journal/aloi-pilioko.html): Aloï Pilioko in the PacificaRomania collection.
- [Living Ancestors — PacificaRomania Journal](https://www.pacificaromania.space/journal/asaro-mudmen.html): The Asaro Mudmen legend and the Eastern Highlands spirit mask.
- [Dreaming the Sacred: Eliade & the Masks of Malaysia — PacificaRomania Journal](https://www.pacificaromania.space/journal/eliade-and-the-masks-of-malaysia.html): How Mah Meri ritual shaped a Romanian historian of religion.
- [Moyang Siamang — The Primate Ancestor Spirit — PacificaRomania Journal](https://www.pacificaromania.space/journal/moyang-siamang.html): A carved cosmology at the edge of three worlds: the sacred primate through Orang Asli, Chinese, and Indian eyes.
- [The Power of the Vessel — PacificaRomania Journal](https://www.pacificaromania.space/journal/naga-morsarang.html): Batak medicine containers, from empty horn to complete cosmogram.
- [The Spirit of the Tomoko — PacificaRomania Journal](https://www.pacificaromania.space/journal/nguzu-nguzu-and-the-tomoko.html): Maritime ritual and cultural resilience in the Solomon Islands.
- [The Sacralization of Measure — PacificaRomania Journal](https://www.pacificaromania.space/journal/the-sacralization-of-measure.html): Burmese weights in the PacificaRomania collection.
- [Spiritual Armor: The Sacred Papot — PacificaRomania Journal](https://www.pacificaromania.space/journal/the-sacred-papot.html): Dayak baby carriers as portable sacred centres.
- [Journal — PacificaRomania](https://www.pacificaromania.space/journal.html): Curatorial essays from the PacificaRomania collection, connecting Pacific and Southeast Asian art to Mircea Eliade
